Finite.{u_3} (α : Sort u_3) : PropA type is `Finite` if it is in bijective correspondence to some `Fin n`. This is similar to `Fintype`, but `Finite` is a proposition rather than data. One other notable difference is that `Finite` allows there to be `Finite p` instances for all `p : Prop`, which is not allowed by `Fintype` due to universe constraints.
